q.en: Which section shows payouts and the Tally export?
q.hi: Payouts aur Tally export kis section mein dikhte hain?

x.en: Earnings & Settlements shows each payout cycle, deductions and the Tally XML / CSV export.
x.hi: Earnings & Settlements mein har payout cycle, deductions aur Tally XML / CSV export hai.

hi: Deductions se pehle total bikri ki value

x.en: GMV (gross merchandise value) is the total value sold, before commission, refunds and other deductions.
x.hi: GMV (gross merchandise value) commission, refunds aur deductions se pehle ki total bikri hai.

q.en: Golden rule of the vendor portal?

hi: Vendor propose karta hai, admin approve karta hai

x.en: Warehouses, price and policy changes and e-way bills all need admin approval.
x.hi: Warehouses, price aur policy changes aur e-way bills sab admin approval maangte hain.

q.en: Where does a product's name always come from?
q.hi: Product ka naam hamesha kahan se aata hai?

x.en: Vendors never type product names. They pick from the master catalog.
x.hi: Vendor kabhi product ka naam type nahi karta. Master catalog se chunta hai.

q.en: While a price request is pending, the SKU sells at…
q.hi: Price request pending rehte hue SKU kis price pe bikta hai?

x.en: Until the admin accepts, the admin's price applies.
x.hi: Admin accept kare tab tak admin ka price lagta hai.

q.hi: Allow COD kahan set hota hai?

x.en: Cash on delivery is a checkbox on each SKU.
x.hi: Cash on delivery har SKU pe ek checkbox hai.

q.en: A new warehouse is saved. Its status?

x.en: New warehouses are pending until the admin verifies the pickup address and approves.
x.hi: Naya warehouse admin ke verify aur approve karne tak pending rehta hai.

hi: Us warehouse ke items temporarily chhupata hai

x.en: Pause Intake hides items temporarily, e.g. during a stock count or holiday.
x.hi: Pause Intake items ko temporarily chhupata hai, jaise stock count ya holiday mein.

q.en: Verify pickup first or approve first?
q.hi: Pehle pickup verify ya pehle approve?

en: Verify in Shiprocket first, then approve
hi: Pehle Shiprocket mein verify, phir approve

x.en: Agreed process: verify in Shiprocket, then approve, so vendors never see a pickup error.
x.hi: Agreed process: Shiprocket mein verify, phir approve, taaki vendor ko pickup error na dikhe.

x.en: Dismiss is not cancel. The order still waits in Orders.
x.hi: Dismiss cancel nahi hai. Order Orders mein wait karta rehta hai.

q.en: Which dispatch option sends customer SMS updates?
q.hi: Kaunsa dispatch option customer ko SMS bhejta hai?

x.en: SMS comes from Shiprocket. Local-driver dispatch sends none.
x.hi: SMS Shiprocket se aata hai. Local driver pe nahi jaata.

q.en: Where does the pickup slot confirmation arrive?
q.hi: Pickup slot confirmation kahan aata hai?

en: WhatsApp on the vendor's registered phone
hi: Vendor ke registered phone pe WhatsApp

x.en: Shiprocket sends the slot by WhatsApp; the vendor confirms or changes it there.
x.hi: Shiprocket WhatsApp pe slot bhejta hai; vendor wahin confirm ya change karta hai.

q.en: An order of ₹64,896 is accepted. Extra step?
q.hi: ₹64,896 ka order accept hua. Extra step?

x.en: ₹50,000 or more needs an e-way bill, reviewed by the admin.
x.hi: ₹50,000 ya zyada pe e-way bill chahiye, admin review karta hai.

q.en: 'Picked up' on a return comes from…
q.hi: Return pe 'Picked up' kahan se aata hai?

x.en: Picked up comes from Shiprocket; Refunded from Razorpay; Escalated from the admin.
x.hi: Picked up Shiprocket se; Refunded Razorpay se; Escalated admin se.

q.hi: Suspended vendor kya kar sakta hai?

x.en: Suspended means read-only: view and export only.
x.hi: Suspended matlab read-only: sirf dekhna aur export.

q.en: What was agreed about staff logins?
q.hi: Staff logins ke baare mein kya agree hua?

en: Remove dashboard and sales from staff logins
hi: Staff logins se dashboard aur sales hatana
Staff hamesha saare warehouses dekhte hain

x.en: Dashboard and sales numbers will be removed from staff logins so business figures stay with the owner.
x.hi: Staff logins se dashboard aur sales hataye jaayenge taaki business figures owner ke paas rahein.
